specification.outcome: When a user asks in normal conversation to create an ordinary ticket, Tiber publishes an unclaimed Backlog task without requiring or changing a campaign.

scenarios.name: create with no campaign checkpoint
then: metadata parses, then host generates and parses task UUID,event UUID,UTC occurrence before constructing one deeply frozen TaskCreatedEvent
exact projected defaults are validated and no campaign/readiness/work adapter runs

scenarios.name: create while unrelated campaign active
then: ordinary task-created publishes with task id,title,description only
campaign bytes unchanged and campaign adapter untouched

scenarios.name: reject malformed or invalid authority values
given: request shape invalid; metadata parser rejects; generated task UUID parser rejects; generated event UUID parser rejects; or generated occurrence parser rejects
then: shape returns TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID; every later value failure returns TIBER_TASK_VALUE_INVALID
no subsequent generator after first failure and no task remote,readiness,claim,journal,worktree,campaign operation occurs

scenarios.name: reject publication failures by phase
when: pre-read/history fails; configured signer absent; signing or push repeatedly fails; or post-push observation/projection degrades
then: each signing/push retry repeats clone,fetch,checkout,history verification,event fold,file write,sign,push with same event values, maximum four total attempts
post-push degradation may mean push succeeded; operation neither rolls back nor republishes and reports failure for independent recovery

scenarios.name: route ticket and campaign language
given: scripted model receives workflow guidance and representative ticket,missing-title,campaign,or mixed request
then: ticket emits exact create-task payload; explicit campaign emits campaign-start; missing-title or mixed request emits clarification with no tool call
parser and schema independently reject any mismatched payload

scenarios.name: return success only from complete exact projection
given: event published and writable board projected
then: it validates ID,title,description,state Backlog,blockStatus unblocked,all specification/claim/review/delivery/CI/campaign Options none,preservedIncrements empty
only then returns exact created text/details
missing or any mismatched default returns TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID

acceptanceCriteria: Workflow request exact shape {kind:'create-task',title:string,description:string}; required keys only. Unknown kind, extra key, missing/null/wrong type each covered.

Metadata parsing occurs before generators. Generation order task UUID,event UUID,occurrence time; each output passes parseTaskId,parseTaskEventId,parseTaskEventOccurredAt. Any generated parse failure is TIBER_TASK_VALUE_INVALID and suppresses remaining generation/effects.

Exact event {schemaVersion:1,eventId,kind:'task-created',occurredAt,task:{id,title,description}} has no campaign field. Construct outside GitTaskRemote and recursively freeze. Across retry, deep values/event JSON and nested task values are identical; object-reference equality is not required.

Projected exact defaults: state:'Backlog',blockStatus:'unblocked',specification/specificationDigest/claim/finalReviewProgress/completionRelease/delivery/ci/openedReview/reviewReceipt/campaignProvenance each {kind:'none'},preservedIncrements:[],plus exact metadata/ID.
Create branch invokes no campaign/readiness/work/run-journal/worktree adapter. Boundary spies assert zero calls for absent/active campaign, every denial, and success.

GitTaskRemote attempt means full fresh clone,task-ref fetch,checkout,signature/history verification,fold with the same event,event-file write,commit signing,and fast-forward push. Signing/push exceptions restart that full sequence for at most four total attempts. Verified-history/fold degraded result returns immediately. After a successful push, read/projection degradation returns immediately without rollback or duplicate publish in that invocation, even though remote success may be uncertain.
Final degraded board, generated task absence, or mismatch of any default maps TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID and cannot format success.
Success content 'Task created: <taskId>\nBacklog | unspecified | unclaimed'; details {disposition:'created',taskId,state:'Backlog',specification:'unspecified',claim:'unclaimed'}.

Routing is tested with deterministic scripted model boundaries: workflow guidance/tool schema are fixed; scripted outputs for examples are asserted as calls or no-call clarification. Unit tests cover schema/parser independently; no live-provider assertion is used.

Guidance rules: explicit single ticket creation uses create-task (description '' if omitted); no title or mixed create+campaign asks clarification with no call; explicit single campaign-start retains campaign-start; a ticket about campaigns is still create-task.
dependencies: workflow-request tool TypeBox schema, injectable IdentifierSource/Clock, dispatcher/result
specification.architectureImplications: Add one closed create-task request through existing signed TaskCreatedEvent. Host parses metadata and generated authority values in order, publishes one immutable event, validates complete projection, and invokes no campaign/readiness/work transition.
